collar_tag_req: Ensure that the dog wears the current license issued for the dog at all times while off the owner's property.

collar_tag_req: Every owner shall affix to his dog a valid tag issued by the City in accordance with this by-law and shall keep such tag affixed on the dog at all times when the dog is not on the owner's property.
dog_limit: No owner shall have more than three (3) dogs in any residential dwelling unit or any structure used for commercial, industrial or institutional purposes within the City.

collar_tag_req: Tag issued upon fee paid; must be kept affixed to the dog.
dog_limit: Maximum of 3 dogs per location, with exceptions for animal hospitals, pounds, zoos, parks.

collar_tag_req: Securely affix on the collar of the dog the tag issued by the Township or its representative.
dog_limit: The maximum number of dogs shall be two (2) per property in a settlement area within the Township. A maximum number of four (4) dogs per property are permitted outside of the settlement area boundaries, unless the landowner possesses a valid Kennel License.

Farm-friendly limit structure: Allows up to 4 dogs outside of settlement areas (rural/agricultural properties) compared to 2 dogs in settlement areas, though no explicit definition for working dogs exists.

collar_tag_req: A pet ID tag and/or microchip with contact information is required.
dog_limit: No owner shall keep or permit to be kept in excess of 3 dogs on a lot.

collar_tag_req: Every owner shall affix to his or her dog the licence tag issued... and shall keep such tag affixed on the dog at all times.
dog_limit: No person shall keep more than a total of two dogs in any Urban Area within the Town of Cochrane (Exemptions for licensed kennels). No maximum limit applies to Rural Areas.

collar_tag_req: DOG TAG - shall mean a personal tag provided by the owner with identifying information i.e., name, telephone number.
dog_limit: Not explicitly restricted for general households, though keeping more than 5 dogs constitutes a Kennel.

collar_tag_req: Every person shall license a dog within 1 week after the dog comes into their care or possession and affix the tag.
dog_limit: No person shall keep or permit to be kept more than 3 dogs within or about any dwelling unit in the Municipality of Grey Highlands... with exception to a licensed kennel.

While the Canine Control By-law lacks LGD definitions, the municipality's Noise Control By-law (2018-063) specifically exempts barking noises from 'an animal used for, and located on, the property of an agriculture, livestock based use', which is very farm friendly.

lgd_definition: “Livestock Guardian Dog” means a dog that is specifically trained to work and live with domestic farm animals ( i. e. cattle, sheep) without causing them harm while aggressively repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose, and includes the following breeds; Akbash, Great Pyrenees, Komondor, and Maremma.
herding_definition: “Farm Working Dog” means a dog that is specifically trained to and actively assists its owner(s) with the herding of livestock and where the owner(s) can demonstrate that they are an active livestock farmer...
collar_tag_req: Every owner of a dog, until ceasing to be the owner of the dog, shall obtain a licence.
dog_limit: There is a three (3) dog limit in each household on all properties within the Town. Any household exceeding three (3) dogs must apply for a Kennel License.
notes: BYLAW NOT FOUND AT ORIGINAL URL. Found By-law 2018-26 via web search. Highly farm-friendly by-law that explicitly defines both 'Livestock Guardian Dog' and 'Farm Working Dog' and includes them as mitigating factors in dangerous dog/biting assessments.

lgd_definition: “Livestock Guardian Animal” means an animal that works and/or lives with domestic farm animals (eg. Cattle, sheep, poultry) to protect them while repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose.
herding_definition: “Herding Dog” means a dog that has been trained to and is actively being used in a bona fide farming operation for the purposes of controlling livestock on the farm
collar_tag_req: The Owner shall keep the tag securely fixed on the dog for which it was issued at all times (except while lawfully hunting in the bush).
dog_limit: No person shall keep more than three (3) dogs at one location.
notes: BYLAW NOT FOUND AT ORIGINAL URL. Retrieved the text of the Responsible Pet Owners By-law 94-077 via web search. Very farm friendly. By-law 94-077 was amended (2022-0056) to explicitly define 'Livestock Guardian Animal' and 'Herding Dog', and entirely exempts them from municipal licensing fees.

collar_tag_req: Identification tag corresponding to the licence issued for dog or cat must be attached to the dog or cat at all times.
dog_limit: No person shall own, possess or harbour in any one (1) household or on any premises more than three (3) dogs. Exception provided for properties with a minimum of three (3) acres of land.
notes: BYLAW NOT FOUND AT ORIGINAL URL. Found Animal By-law No. 73-2021 and its amendment By-law 98-2021 via web search. It is farm-friendly because it grants an acreage-based exemption to the 3-dog limit for properties of at least 3 acres. The town's Noise and Nuisance By-law (83-2023) is also farm friendly, explicitly exempting persistent animal barking/howling from enforcement if it is a 'normal farm practice carried on by an agricultural operation'.

lgd_definition: Livestock Guardian Dogs are explicitly listed as an exemption class under Section 1.12.4 (Amended by By-Law 105-22).
herding_definition: HERDING DOG means a Dog that has been trained and is actively being used in a bona fide farming operation for the purposes of guarding, control or protection of Livestock on a farm.
collar_tag_req: Every License issued under this By-Law shall expire at 12:00 midnight one year from the day on which the License was issued.
dog_limit: No Person shall own, control, possess, board or harbor more than two (2) Dogs on any property. Exemption: A bona fide farmer to a maximum of six (6) Herding Dogs and Livestock Guardian Dogs on an operating farm property.
notes: BYLAW NOT FOUND AT ORIGINAL URL. Found Consolidated Animal Control By-Law 069-22 on the Town's website. Highly farm-friendly. The bylaw was amended in 2022 (By-law 105-22) specifically to introduce exemptions for 'sheep dogs and livestock guardian dogs', raising the limit from 2 dogs up to 6 dogs for bona fide farmers on operating farm properties.

collar_tag_req: The owner of the dog shall keep the dog tag securely affixed on the dog for which it was issued at all times until renewed or replaced, except that it may be removed while the dog is confined to the owner's property.
dog_limit: No dwelling or property within the Municipality shall house more than two (2) dogs with the exception of the rural areas in which case up to four (4) dogs shall be allowed.
notes: BYLAW NOT FOUND AT ORIGINAL URL. The 'Keeping of Animals' By-Law Number 150-2010 explicitly waives the licensing fee for a certified 'working dog' (defined strictly as assistance dogs). Features a farm-friendly higher dog limit (4 dogs) in rural areas vs urban areas (2 dogs).

collar_tag_req: Cats and dogs within the Township need to be registered and a tag affixed to the collar of the dog.
dog_limit: No more than four (4) dogs may be owned and reside at a single property in the Township at the same time.
notes: BYLAW NOT FOUND AT ORIGINAL URL. Found Animal Control By-law 2016-85 via web search. Standard limit of 4 dogs per property. No specific farm/working dog exemptions found in the By-law.

collar_tag_req: Dog Tags must be purchased annually for all dogs in Loyalist Township in accordance with the Municipal Dog Control By-law.
dog_limit: You can purchase tags for up to three dogs per household. Households with more than 3 dogs must apply for a Kennel Licence.
notes: BYLAW NOT FOUND AT ORIGINAL URL. Dog Control By-law 2011-069 establishes a limit of 3 dogs per household. No explicit livestock guardian dog or farm dog definitions or exemptions found through available documentation.

lgd_definition: “Livestock Guardian Dog” (LGDs) means a dog that works and/or lives with domestic farm animals (e.g. cattle, sheep, poultry) to protect them while repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose.
herding_definition: “Herding Dog” means a dog that has been trained and is actively being used in a bona fide farming operation for the purposes of controlling livestock on the farm.
collar_tag_req: Livestock Guardian Dogs and Herding dogs shall be exempt from ensuring the Dog identification tag is displayed on the dog collar while the dog is being actively used in farming practices provided the owner uses an alternative means of identification linking the animal to the name and address.

collar_tag_req: Every owner of a dog shall affix an identity tag or plate or a Municipal issued dog ID tag/license to each dog in their ownership.
dog_limit: No person shall have more than three (3) dogs in any residential dwelling unit or any structure used for commercial, industrial or institutional purposes within the Municipality.
